scan_frequency: one hour; cheap context on all 24 pinned symbols, focus four by boundary proximity then published rolling quote activity
entry_bar: signal closes at T, native execution bar opens at T; no signal-bar fill
breakout: prior 24h boundary excludes arming-hour bar; two later 5m closes accept; subsequent retest touch within 0.10 ATR1h and close <=0.75 ATR1h beyond boundary, rvol>=1; no chase >1.25 ATR1h
sweep: prior 24h boundary; completed 5m excursion 0.05 to 1.5 ATR1h and reclaim; later close beyond reclaim-bar high/low with rvol>=1; simultaneous 1h/4h EMA and 1h structure opposing blocks reversal until new hypothesis
stop: outside retest/boundary or full sweep extreme, plus 0.15 ATR1h; minimum .0025 and maximum .025 of entry
target: Before nearest still-unconsumed, relevant-side pre-known 1h/4h 2L2R pivot in seven-day map, or range boundary/midpoint; .05 ATR1h buffer, <=6 ATR1h distance. Prior completed close through a pivot consumes its old role; a role flip requires a new explicit hypothesis.
thesis_exit: two completed closes against boundary by more than .15 ATR1h; distinct from native protective stop
funding: actual source event ms with same-hour mark open, strict (entry,exit] allocation; hourly mark approximation
development_revision: v3.0.0 latest-swing-only map could omit older obstacles; v3.0.1 all-pivot map over-rejected by retaining already-broken levels. v3.0.2 uses causal active level lifecycle. These are engineering/market-logic corrections, not profit-selected thresholds.
